title: sremu native data-plane frame header, version 1 (DESIGN.md section 8.3)
description: Binary, not JSON: this file documents the 48-byte little-endian header of the two-part ZMQ message [header, payload] (TX ingress PUSH->PULL at tcp://127.0.0.1:5602; RX egress PULL from the endpoint returned by stream.open). The schema below validates a decoded header written as a JSON object (field names as in x-layout). Frames failing any check are dropped and counted as BAD_PACKET.

x-layout.name: flags
x-layout.note: b0 SOB, b1 EOB, b2 HAS_TIME, b3 IDLE_UNTIL, b4 OVERFLOW_BEFORE, b5 LATE, b6 END_OF_STREAM; other bits must be 0

x-layout.name: seq
x-layout.note: per-stream frame counter from 0; a gap -> SEQ_ERROR async

x-layout.name: first_sample
x-layout.note: absolute index at the stream rate (TX: iff HAS_TIME, else the frontier; IDLE_UNTIL: the idle-until index; RX: always)

x-layout.name: dtype
x-layout.note: 1 cf32_le (8 bytes/sample), 2 sc16_le (4 bytes/sample, full scale 32767)
